# More catalogues, reading, the library and the shop, after 10_kurotoon set things up
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 4
tapx Browse
tapx Extensions
sleep 4
tap Search
type Webtoons
sleep 5
shot ext_webtoons
tapx Install
sleep 15
tapif INSTALL
tapif Install
sleep 25
shot ext_webtoons_done
tapif Reset
tapif "Navigate up"
tap Search
type Asura
sleep 5
shot ext_asura
tapx Install
sleep 15
tapif INSTALL
tapif Install
sleep 25
shot ext_asura_done
start app.kurotoon.dev
tapx Browse
tapx Sources
sleep 3
shot sources

sleep 3
shot reader_chapters
back
back
sleep 2
back
sleep 2
back
sleep 2
